description: Makes the usual favicon set from a logo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or JPEG XL): favicon.ico (16, 32, 48 px), 16/32 px PNGs, apple-touch-icon, the Android 192/512 icons and site.webmanifest, centred on a square with optional padding and background, plus the <link> tags to paste into <head>.

background.description: Hex fill behind the image (default transparent)

name: favicon_create
title: Favicon pack from an image
